items.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
items.summary: Morgan Stanley posted third-quarter results that beat expectations on blockbuster results in its equities trading franchise.

items.title: Bank of America shares drop 8% after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
items.summary: Bank of America on Wednesday posted a sharp profit decline after being hit with a $1.2 billion penalty by U.S. regulators, while revenue also disappointed after trading operations generated about $750 million less than expected.

items.title: China's exports and imports surge past expectations in September
items.summary: BEIJING — China's exports grew by 36.3% in September from a year ago, their fastest pace since February, according to official data released Wednesday.

items.title: Goldman says investors are looking for 'profitable' Chinese business growth overseas
items.summary: BEIJING — Equity investors are skeptical of Chinese companies' rapid expansion overseas, according to Goldman Sachs.

items.title: Williams says Fed may not have to hike rates in 2027, at odds with traders
items.summary: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said Tuesday that he doesn't see additional rate hikes in 2027 after one more increase this year.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase won't allow outside artificial intelligence agents to access customer accounts and operate on their behalf, CEO Jamie Dimon said Tuesday, citing risks to the company and its customers as tech firms including Meta release autonomous assistants.

items.title: How high inflation became a 'fact of life' in the U.S.
items.summary: U.S. consumers are in the midst of one of the longest stretches of elevated inflation of the past century.

items.title: Consumer prices rose 3.7% annually in September as gas prices skyrocket
items.summary: September brought little relief to the accelerating cost of living, as consumer prices increased again and kept the inflation rate well above the Federal Reserve's goal.

items.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
items.summary: BANGKOK — The Philippine central bank is planning for a "Godzilla" El Niño on top of a prolonged oil shock, as the Southeast Asian nation tries to rein in inflation from three-year highs.

items.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
items.summary: Wednesday's closely watched reading on consumer prices could show intensifying inflationary pressures as energy costs keep climbing.
